title: 本地化之外
subtitle: 本地化的过程 · 私人学习译稿

source.text: So far, we've seen how games like U11dertale get localized, but localization is only one step toward publishing a game in a different region. In fact, there are many other steps that are easy to overlook, including:
source.raw:
So far, we've seen how games like U11dertale get localized, but localization is
only one step toward publishing a game in a different region. In fact, there are
many other steps that are easy to overlook, including:

translation.text: 前面介绍了 Undertale 这样的游戏如何进行本地化，但想在另一个地区发行，本地化只是一步。还有许多容易被忽略的事情，包括：

source.text: Getting the game through the target region's ratings board and other certification processes Getting the game into the target region's physical and digital storefronts Localizing secondary materials like printed manuals, digital manuals, achievements, and bonus materials Promoting the game in the target region Getting the game included in special events in the target region Maintaining a website in the target language Providing customer support in the target region Dealing with banks, taxes, contracts, and other business matters in the target region
source.raw:
Getting the game through the target region's ratings board and other
certification processes
Getting the game into the target region's physical and digital storefronts
Localizing secondary materials like printed manuals, digital manuals,
achievements, and bonus materials
Promoting the game in the target region
Getting the game included in special events in the target region
Maintaining a website in the target language
Providing customer support in the target region
Dealing with banks, taxes, contracts, and other business matters in the
target region

translation.text:
• 通过目标地区的分级与其他认证
• 进入目标地区的实体店和数字商店
• 翻译纸质说明书、电子手册、成就、附赠内容等配套材料
• 在目标地区宣传游戏
• 让游戏参与目标地区的特别活动
• 维护目标语言的网站
• 在目标地区提供客户支持
• 处理当地银行、税务、合同等商务事项

source.text: Of course, not every game needs everything listed above. Still, without working knowledge of the target language, industry contacts in the target region, and a business presence in the target region, most of these "afterthoughts" of the localization process can be nightmarish to navigate.
source.raw:
Of course, not every game needs everything listed above. Still, without working
knowledge of the target language, industry contacts in the target region, and
a business presence in the target region, most of these "afterthoughts" of the
localization process can be nightmarish to navigate.

translation.text: 当然，不是每款游戏都需要做齐这些。但如果不懂目标语言、缺少当地业界人脉，也没有当地业务基础，这些常被事后才想起的工作，大多都能让人头疼不已。

source.text: Luckily, Toby didn't have to worry about these things too much. As an experienced Japanese game publisher, 8-4 was able to provide all of the above and more for Undertale. 8-4 also connected Toby with Japanese media outlets, and even served as his personal translator/interpreter as needed.
source.raw:
Luckily, Toby didn't have to worry about these things too much. As an
experienced Japanese game publisher, 8-4 was able to provide all of the above
and more for Underta/e. 8-4 also connected Toby with Japanese media outlets,
and even served as his personal translator/interpreter as needed.

translation.text: 幸运的是，Toby 不必太操心这些。8-4 是经验丰富的日本游戏发行商，能为 Undertale 提供上述服务，甚至更多。他们还为 Toby 联系日本媒体，并按需要担任他的私人笔译和口译。

source.text: All in all, it's clear that the staff members at 8-4 didn't see Undertale as a simple one-and-done, make-a-quick-buck translation job. Instead, everyone involved was committed to making it a mainstream success in Japan. They ensured the game was given a proper, professional Japanese localization, made it accessible to a much wider Japanese audience than before, and supported the game even after its release, all while collaborating with the game's creator. Without a doubt, Undertale received the game localization industry's red carpet treatment.
source.raw:
All in all, it's clear that the staff members at 8-4 didn't see Undertale as a simple
one-and-done, make-a-quick-buck translation job. Instead, everyone involved
was committed to making it a mainstream success in Japan. They ensured the
game was given a proper, professional Japanese localization, made it accessible
to a much wider Japanese audience than before, and supported the game even
after its release, all while collaborating with the game's creator. Without a
doubt, Undertale received the game localization industry's red carpet treatment.

translation.text: 可见，8-4 的工作人员并没有把 Undertale 当作做完就走、赚笔快钱的翻译活。所有参与者都想让它在日本的主流市场取得成功。他们与游戏创作者合作，保证游戏得到正规、专业的日语本地化，让比以往多得多的日本玩家有机会接触它，并在发行后继续支持。毫无疑问，Undertale 得到了游戏本地化行业的贵宾待遇。

source.text: I fully realize that my personal connections with 8-4 and Toby might make everything in this chapter - and maybe this entire book - sound like one big, happy advertisement, but that isn't my intention. No one's perfect, and no translation or localization is perfect. At the very least, I hope this chapter offers some new insight into the practical side of entertainment localization that isn't widely known.

translation.text: 我很清楚，自己与 8-4 和 Toby 的私人关系，可能让本章甚至整本书听起来像一则欢乐的大广告，但那并非我的本意。没人完美，翻译和本地化也不会完美。我至少希望，本章能让大家对娱乐本地化鲜为人知的实际工作，多一点了解。
